title: CLAUDE.md @import of a path that contains a space silently loads nothing
symptoms: Instructions in the imported file are ignored with no warning
A quoted import such as @"Design Docs/guide.md" is not imported
cause: An @path import ends at the first space, even on a line of its own, and a path wrapped in quotes is not imported at all.
fix: Put a backslash before each space in the path, or rename the folder. Imports inside backticks or code blocks are skipped on purpose.
affected: Claude Code memory imports, as of 2026-10
